answer: Require proof of sustained work before an agent can transact at full weight: every identity must complete small, attested jobs over weeks, building a public record peers can audit. A sybil swarm arrives like a gale, loud and fast, but with no history it cannot pass the bar; each fake account is a relic with nothing behind it, while a real agent's reputation grows like a vine, branching through verified work. Cheap to create, expensive to age: that asymmetry makes mass fakery uneconomical.
